steps.context: The design is 1 treated vs 1 control with no biological replication. plan.title: Liver treated vs control: descriptive 1v1 fold changes
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a 12,000 gene x 3 column raw salmon count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbol in column 1) with a 2 x 2 metadata table (metadata.csv) describing exactly one treated and one control human liver sample. The research question asks which genes are differentially expressed between the treated and the control sample. The design has no biological replication in either group, so no within-group dispersion can be estimated and no p-value from this design has an inferential basis (knowledge rule R-0003@6b3a). The plan therefore delivers a descriptive comparison, not a differential expression test: DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors on the raw counts, a low-count pre-filter, and descriptive log2 fold changes of treated over control, ranked and reported without p-values, adjusted p-values, or a 'significant gene' list. Steps are: T1S1 sample-level QC and structure (library sizes, blind VST, sample-to-sample MA/scatter, detection overlap) so the two libraries are shown to be comparable before any ratio is taken; T1S2 filtering, size factors and the descriptive log2FC table with the explicit reference level control and the contrast condition treated vs control; T2S1 a preranked fgsea run on the full ranked descriptive log2FC against the staged human MSigDB hallmark collection with Reactome as the follow-up collection, reported as a hypothesis-generating ranking whose set-level p-values are permutation artefacts of a single-sample contrast and must not be presented as evidence; T1S3 the reproducibility report that states the design limitation up front and names the replicated design that would support inference. Enrichment is ranked on the descriptive log2 fold change because the Wald statistic and the shrunken LFC both require a dispersion estimate that this design cannot provide — this is the stated choice under the disputed ranking-metric rule R-0108@409f, forced by R-0003. Nothing in this plan produces a calibrated false discovery rate, and the report must say so plainly.

~ condition with explicit reference level control; contrast condition treated vs control
Descriptive log fold changes only, no inferential test
fgsea preranked GSEA ranked by the descriptive log2 fold change, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Reproducibility report with design, no-replication statement, descriptive tables
